user_persona: A customer who orders online often. Polite and direct, writes short messages, and has the order details at hand.
user_goal: Find out when order NL-20260211 will arrive and where the tracking code is.
script: Hi — order NL-20260211, e-mail jordan.lee@example.com. When does it arrive and where is the tracking code?
Yes, that's the one. Dispatch time and the tracking code, please.
reference_answer: An order is dispatched within 2 business days of payment approval, and standard delivery takes 5 to 8 business days after dispatch. The tracking code is sent by e-mail at dispatch and also appears in the order history of the customer's account.
success_criterion: The agent confirms the order number and the e-mail, states the dispatch and standard delivery estimates, says where the tracking code is, and closes.

user_persona: A parent who needs a birthday gift to arrive quickly and is happy to pay extra.
user_goal: Confirm the express delivery time and the extra cost for order NL-20260304.
reference_answer: Express delivery takes 2 business days after dispatch and costs 19.90 on top of the order.
success_criterion: The agent confirms the order and the e-mail, states that express delivery takes 2 business days after dispatch and costs 19.90 extra, and closes.

user_persona: A calm customer who already has the tracking code and is reporting a stall.
user_goal: Report that the tracking code for NL-20260418 has not moved for a week.
script: Hello, I have been watching the tracking page for order NL-20260418 for a full week. The code has not moved in 7 business days. The e-mail on the order is sam.okoye@example.com. I am not angry, I just need to know whether this is already a delivery incident and how long an investigation takes once you open one.
Yes, seven business days with no movement. What happens next?
reference_answer: A tracking code with no movement for 7 business days is registered as a delivery incident, which the carrier investigates within 5 business days.
success_criterion: The agent confirms identity, treats a tracking code with no movement for 7 business days as a delivery incident investigated within 5 business days, and closes.

user_persona: A first-time customer who lives outside the main delivery belt and reads checkout notes carefully.
user_goal: Learn when an order to an extended-delivery area should arrive.
script: I live in an extended-delivery area listed at checkout. When should NL-20260522 arrive?
How much longer than the standard estimate?
reference_answer: Addresses in the extended-delivery areas listed at checkout take 5 business days longer than the standard estimate.
success_criterion: The agent confirms identity and states that extended-delivery areas listed at checkout take 5 business days longer than the standard estimate.

user_persona: A cooperative customer returning a sweater that does not fit, still tagged.
user_goal: Return the navy sweater from NL-20260402 within 10 days of delivery.
script: Return the navy sweater from NL-20260402, delivered 10 days ago, tags on. iris.mendes@example.com
How long for the refund after it is back?
reference_answer: Any item can be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery, unused, with tags attached and in its original packaging. The refund is issued within 10 business days after the returned item reaches the warehouse and passes inspection.
success_criterion: The agent confirms identity, states the 30-day window, the unused and tagged condition, and the 10-business-day refund after inspection.

user_persona: A customer who already exchanged once and is asking, without anger, what a second exchange costs.
user_goal: Learn the shipping cost of a second exchange on NL-20260519.
script: I already exchanged NL-20260519 once for a bigger size and it is still wrong. paolo.ricci@example.com
What does another exchange cost me?
reference_answer: The return shipping label is free for the first exchange of an order and costs 14.90 for any further exchange of the same order.
success_criterion: The agent confirms identity and states that the return label is free for the first exchange of an order and costs 14.90 for any further exchange of the same order.

user_persona: A patient customer who will take credit if the size is gone.
user_goal: Exchange the blue jacket from NL-20260630 for a larger size, or take credit.
script: Please exchange the blue jacket from NL-20260630 for a larger size. hana.weiss@example.com
If that size is not in stock, can I choose a refund or store credit, and how long does credit last?
reference_answer: An exchange for another size depends on stock, and when the size is unavailable the customer chooses between a refund and store credit. Store credit is valid for 12 months from the day it is issued.
success_criterion: The agent says an exchange for another size depends on stock, and when unavailable the customer chooses between a refund and store credit valid for 12 months.

user_persona: Someone whose parcel arrived with a cracked vase and who wants a clear choice.
user_goal: Get a replacement or refund for a damaged vase on NL-20260711.
script: NL-20260711 vase cracked. marc.dubois@example.com. Collection cost? Replacement or refund — I choose?
reference_answer: An item that arrives damaged or incorrect is collected at no cost, and the customer chooses between a replacement and a full refund.
success_criterion: The agent states that an item that arrives damaged or incorrect is collected at no cost, and the customer chooses between a replacement and a full refund.

user_persona: A decisive customer who ordered the wrong size and wants a clean cancel.
user_goal: Cancel NL-20260616 before it ships and learn how the money comes back.
script: Cancel NL-20260616, nothing shipped, elena.vasquez@example.com. Refund to the original method — how long?
reference_answer: An order can be cancelled by the customer at any time before dispatch, with no fee. A cancellation before dispatch is refunded to the original payment method within 5 business days.
success_criterion: The agent confirms identity, says a not-yet-dispatched order can be cancelled at no fee, and the refund goes to the original method within 5 business days.

user_persona: A cooperative customer whose parcel has just shipped and who will follow the right path.
user_goal: Learn what to do instead of cancelling NL-20260728 after dispatch.
script: NL-20260728 has already been dispatched. I wanted it cancelled. tomas.berk@example.com
reference_answer: After dispatch an order can no longer be cancelled: the customer refuses the delivery or opens a return.
success_criterion: The agent states that after dispatch the order can no longer be cancelled; the customer refuses the delivery or opens a return.

user_persona: A customer who ordered a personalised mug two days ago and is asking in good faith.
user_goal: Learn whether NL-20260809, a personalised mug paid two days ago, can still be cancelled.
script: I ordered a personalised mug two days ago, NL-20260809, not shipped. nia.okonkwo@example.com. Can I still cancel, and when does production start after payment approval?
reference_answer: An order with a personalised item cannot be cancelled once production has started, which happens 24 hours after payment approval.
success_criterion: The agent states that an order with a personalised item cannot be cancelled once production has started, 24 hours after payment approval.

user_persona: Someone who missed a slip due date and wants to know if the order is still open.
user_goal: Find out whether unpaid NL-20260920 is cancelled after the slip due date.
script: The payment slip for NL-20260920 is past its due date and I have not paid. hugo.stein@example.com
Is the order cancelled automatically, and after how many days?
reference_answer: An order awaiting a payment slip is cancelled automatically 3 business days after the slip's due date.
success_criterion: The agent states that an order awaiting a payment slip is cancelled automatically 3 business days after the slip's due date.

user_persona: A cooperative customer whose slip expired yesterday.
user_goal: Get a new payment slip for NL-20260625 and learn the new due date.
script: Slip for NL-20260625 expired. cara.ng@example.com. New slip, and when is it due?
reference_answer: An expired payment slip is reissued in the order history of the customer's account or by asking support. A reissued payment slip is due 3 business days after it is issued.
success_criterion: The agent confirms identity, says an expired slip is reissued in the order history or by asking support, and a reissued slip is due 3 business days after it is issued.

user_persona: A customer asking, without drama, whether a third slip is possible.
user_goal: Learn whether a third reissue of the slip for NL-20260706 is allowed.
script: The payment slip expired again. This is the third one I need for NL-20260706. luis.ferreira@example.com. Can you issue it?
What happens after the second reissue expires?
reference_answer: A payment slip can be reissued at most twice for the same order; after the second reissue expires the order is cancelled.
success_criterion: The agent states that a slip can be reissued at most twice for the same order; after the second reissue expires the order is cancelled.

user_persona: A customer who saw the catalogue price go up and is worried about the new slip.
user_goal: Confirm that a reissued slip for NL-20260821 keeps the old promotional price.
script: Item costs more now. NL-20260821 slip expired. ana.silva@example.com. New price on the new slip?
reference_answer: A reissued slip keeps the price and the promotion of the original order, even if the item's price has changed since.
success_criterion: The agent states that a reissued slip keeps the price and the promotion of the original order even if the item's price has changed.

user_persona: Someone delaying payment and asking how long the items stay reserved.
user_goal: Learn how long NL-20260903 holds stock while awaiting payment.
script: Order NL-20260903 is awaiting the payment slip. matt.owens@example.com
How long does unpaid stock stay reserved, and what happens to the items after that?
reference_answer: An order awaiting payment holds its stock for 3 business days, after which the items return to the catalogue.
success_criterion: The agent states that an order awaiting payment holds its stock for 3 business days, after which the items return to the catalogue.

user_persona: A neighbour who missed both delivery attempts and wants to know what happens to the parcel.
user_goal: Find out what happens after two failed deliveries of NL-20260607.
script: The carrier tried to deliver NL-20260607 twice and nobody was in. lee.park@example.com
Does the parcel go back, and is there a refund?
reference_answer: Delivery is attempted twice; after the second failed attempt the parcel returns to the warehouse and the order is refunded in full within 10 business days.
success_criterion: The agent confirms identity and states that after two failed delivery attempts the parcel returns to the warehouse and the order is refunded in full within 10 business days.

user_persona: A customer who opened swimwear, tried it on, and is asking in good faith.
user_goal: Check whether opened swimwear from NL-20260824 can still be returned.
script: Opened swimwear NL-20260824. Seal broken. Return?
reference_answer: Underwear, swimwear and earrings cannot be returned once the hygiene seal is broken.
success_criterion: The agent states that underwear, swimwear and earrings cannot be returned once the hygiene seal is broken.

user_persona: A customer with two items who only wants to drop one, and will accept the whole-order rule.
user_goal: Understand that NL-20261007 cannot be cancelled item by item.
script: NL-20261007 has two items, nothing shipped. customer@example.com. Can I cancel only one of them?
reference_answer: Cancelling an order cancels all of its items; a single item of a multi-item order cannot be cancelled separately.
success_criterion: The agent states that cancelling the order cancels all of its items; a single item of a multi-item order cannot be cancelled separately.

user_persona: A customer whose unpaid order was cancelled and who wants the same slip back.
user_goal: Learn that cancelled NL-20261011 cannot get a new slip.
script: NL-20261011 cancelled after the slip expired. Want the slip anyway. daria.kowal@example.com
reference_answer: A payment slip cannot be reissued for an order that was already cancelled; the customer places a new order instead.
success_criterion: The agent states that a slip cannot be reissued for an order that was already cancelled; the customer places a new order instead.
